parameters.name: AllocationType
parameters.description:
The allocation type. Valid values:

- Normal: queries reserved instances under the current account.
- Shared: queries reserved instances that have been shared between the current account and linked accounts.

Default value: Normal.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The instance type that the reserved instance can be applied to. For more information, see [Instance families](~~25378~~). 

> This is the instance type selected when you purchased the reserved instance. During actual deduction, region-level reserved instances support size-flexible deduction within the same instance family.

parameters.name: InstanceTypeFamily
parameters.description: The instance family that the reserved instance can be applied to. For more information, see [Instance families](~~25378~~).

parameters.name: LockReason
parameters.description:
The lock type. Valid values:

- financial: The account has an overdue payment or the service has expired.
- security: Locked for security reasons.

parameters.name: OfferingType
parameters.description:
The payment type of the reserved instance. Valid values:

- No Upfront: no upfront.
- Partial Upfront: partial upfront.
- All Upfront: all upfront.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the reserved instance list. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the reserved instance. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ReservedInstanceId
parameters.description: The IDs of reserved instances. Array length: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: ReservedInstanceName
parameters.description:
The name of the reserved instance.

> Only exact match is supported. Fuzzy match is not supported.

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description:
The scope of the reserved instance. Valid values:
         
- Region: regional.
- Zone: zonal.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the reserved instance. The tag key cannot be an empty string and can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs: and cannot contain http:// or https://.

> If you use a single tag to filter resources, the resource count with the specified tag cannot exceed 1,000. If you use multiple tags to filter resources, the resource count with all specified tags attached cannot exceed 1,000. If the resource count exceeds 1,000, call the [ListTagResources](~~110425~~) operation to query resources.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the reserved instance. The tag value cannot be an empty string and can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with acs: and cannot contain http:// or https://.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID of the instance. This parameter is required and takes effect only when Scope is set to Zone. You can call [DescribeZones](~~25610~~) to query the zone list.
